## What's new in v0.2

- **Enemies:** normal enemies have 40-card decks and 20 life; the boss has a 60-card deck, a commander and 30 life.
- **Rewards:** card rewards can't be skipped. Of the three single cards, one comes from your character's hand-picked pool, one from the Full Pool (every nonland Final Fantasy and Foundations card in your colours), and the third from either. Buckets follow your colours, with an occasional off-colour "(splash)" bucket.
- **Shop:** once per visit you can pay to remove every copy of one card (75 gold, then 150, 225, 300 ...). Backing out is free.
- **Lands:** the land picker offers only your deck's colours, picks for you when the deck has one colour, and also offers Final Fantasy's two-colour Towns when both colours are in your deck.
- **Landless cards:** Final Fantasy and Foundations cards that searched for lands now conjure them instead; landcycling is now plain cycling. Card previews show the rewritten text. Cards that can never work without lands are left out of the mode.
- **Levels:** character level 2 comes after one fight, 3 after a boss's worth of experience, 4 after a won run's worth. Account levels add Final Fantasy: Through the Ages (level 4), the two Commander sets (level 6) and the option to switch Full Pool sets off (levels 7 and 9).
